field.label: Enable machine client
field.help: Runs the native Pangolin machine client (olm) on this firewall. It establishes a WireGuard tunnel for this device and, optionally, for selected local networks.

field.label: Pangolin endpoint
field.help: Base URL of your Pangolin instance. HTTPS is required unless the advanced insecure-HTTP override is enabled.

field.label: Client ID
field.help: Machine client ID created in the Pangolin dashboard.

field.label: Client secret
field.help: The secret is stored in config.xml (root-readable) and written to a 0600 agent configuration file. It is never written to logs or status files.

field.label: Organization ID
field.help: Optional organization identifier for multi-organization deployments.

field.label: Interface name
field.help: FreeBSD tun(4) interface created by the agent. Keep the default unless it conflicts with an existing interface.

field.label: MTU
field.help: WireGuard MTU. 1280 is safe over most paths; 1420 is common on clean Ethernet/WAN links.

field.label: Netstack resolver
field.help: Resolver used by the client's internal netstack for endpoint name resolution. Unbound remains the LAN resolver.

field.label: Internal DNS proxy upstreams
field.help: Comma-separated address or address:port resolvers used by the client's internal DNS proxy. These are not used as LAN resolvers.

field.label: Prefer local routes
field.help: Keep overlapping directly connected/local routes preferred over tunnel routes.

field.label: Exit node takes precedence
field.help: When an exit node is active, suppress per-resource routes and aliases so all traffic follows the exit node.
